shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in package.json next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__'"' && rg -n 'use cache|connection\\(|Suspense|fetch\\(|cookies\\(|headers\\(|Date\\(|Math.random|cacheComponents|ppr' app next.config.ts package.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git log -1 --oneline && cat tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import shutil; root=Path(\"/workspace\").resolve(); generated=root/\".next\"; assert generated.is_dir() and (generated/\"server/app/index.html\").is_file(); shutil.rmtree(generated); env=root/\"next-env.d.ts\"; assert env.is_file() and \"This file should not be edited\" in env.read_text(); env.unlink()'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && test ! -e .next && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && echo '"'Generated build files cleaned'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- app/layout.tsx app/loading.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts && cat app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx'
